criteria.statement: Repository, remote, default branch, and project identity are ChangeBridge only.
The exact Stage 4 commit, tree, and PART2_STAGE4_CDC_APPLY_VERIFIED checkpoint are verified.
All predecessor validators pass and protected Part 1 and Part 2 Stage 1-4 evidence remains byte-identical.
Stage 5 scope, write surface, dependencies, exclusions, and claim ceiling are frozen.
A disposable environment installs only repository-declared development and Spark dependencies.
The qualified Iceberg 1.11.0 runtime is checksum verified before use.
ADR-019 supersedes ADR-008 only for executable proof ownership and preserves its fail-closed intent.
Part 2 stage sequencing assigns schema and primary-key policy to Stage 5 without weakening predecessor semantics.
CB-SCHEMA-001 through CB-SCHEMA-003 map to executable Stage 5 policy, control, and evidence.
The schema policy has an immutable identifier, version, canonical material, and digest.
Schema decisions bind generation, table, exact previous and candidate identities, ordered keys, policy, verdict, reasons, and action.
Every Stage 5 failure path has a stable non-overlapping reason code.
Policy, key, decision, quarantine, apply-receipt, and reason-code contracts are cataloged and schema validated.
Contract and decision digests use deterministic canonical JSON and are insensitive to object key order.
orders_source_contract 1.0.0 to 1.1.0 is admitted only as a nullable non-key source_note addition.
Existing six accepted order rows read null for source_note after evolution.
Repeated equivalent decisions and clean real-target runs have identical logical identity.
A field removal is incompatible and fails before target mutation.
A field rename is represented as removal plus addition and fails closed.
A field type change is incompatible and fails before target mutation.
Nullable-to-required evolution is incompatible and fails before target mutation.
A newly required field is incompatible; no default is inferred.
An unknown contract identifier, version, or digest is quarantined before target mutation.
A policy digest mismatch is unknown and quarantined before target mutation.
Primary-key authority is explicit, ordered, typed, non-empty, and non-nullable.
A primary-key definition change is incompatible and rejects the candidate generation.
A primary-key value update is rejected before CDC mutation.
The deterministic schema decision is durable before Iceberg mutation or quarantine.
CDC mutation requires an exact compatible decision and schema-apply receipt for generation, table, candidate, and policy.
Real local Spark and Iceberg atomically commit the supported field and recovery properties.
The apply receipt binds token, decision, policy, candidate digest, Iceberg schema ID, and metadata location.
Identical replay discovers the committed token and produces no second metadata or data commit.
Schema evolution preserves canonical identities and values of pre-existing fields.
Unknown and incompatible changes open durable quarantine before any target mutation.
Quarantine preserves target metadata, data snapshots, and checkpoint 0/194FE20.
Incompatible evolution transitions the candidate generation from CDC_APPLYING to REJECTED.
Unknown evolution blocks admission and requires explicit re-adjudication rather than silent retry.
Process loss after Iceberg schema commit recovers the exact receipt without another schema commit.
Stage 4 target rows, post-snapshot result, and checkpoint remain unchanged by Stage 5.
The accepted compatible generation remains CDC_APPLYING, unpublished, and unsealed.
Unit, property, contract, integration, recovery, quarantine, and generation-rejection tests cover the protocol with no Stage 5 skip.
Ruff, strict mypy, full pytest with coverage, predecessor validators, and the Stage 5 validator pass.
Evidence is deterministic, source-commit/tree bound, schema-valid, complete, and free of secrets and transient paths.
The exact reviewed pull-request head passes every Stage 5 candidate gate.
The guarded merge succeeds only for the reviewed head under repository policy.
Fresh merged main resolves to the expected merge and preserves the reviewed Stage 5 tree.
Fresh merged main passes all frozen predecessor and Stage 5 validators.
The external PART2_STAGE5_SCHEMA_POLICY_VERIFIED checkpoint records exact identities, evidence, limitations, and Stage 6 entry.
